outcome: maternal morbidity (eclampsia, HELLP syndrome, need for blood transfusion)
perinatal morbidity and mortality (preterm birth, stillbirth, neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission, neonatal mortality)
cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women diagnosed with preeclampsia and thrombocytopenia at a tertiary care center.
finding: This clinical study provides valuable insights into the maternal and fetal outcomes of preeclampsia with thrombocytopenia.
